steps.content:
10:00 p.m., January 27, N.F. 113
The Rust - My Best Cool Car Studios temporary base

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: OwO... You don't have to force yourself. If you really can't do it, I-I can do it for you...

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: That's right! Um... why don't you get some sleep first? Maybe you'll get some new ideas after you wake up. You don't have to say goodbye when you're feeling your worst...

steps.speaker: Daisy
steps.content: All right Love, you've said enough...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's fine. I'm OwO, founder of My Best Cool Car Studios. What haven't I been through?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Turn on the camera, ${PlayerName}. I can do it.

steps.speaker: Option
steps.content: ...Turn on the vlog

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hehe... Good evening. This is OwO the lion dancer. It feels like it's been a while. I really miss everyone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: These past few days, we ventured into Dillywood, walked the red carpet, and got swarmed by reporters. We also met Stella's family. Though we were really close, we weren't able to send Stella home. But we'll definitely succeed next time.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want to thank all my followers. I know there aren't that many, but each and every one of you has given My Best Cool Car the strength it needs. Thank you so much.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I also want to thank all my buddies at My Best Cool Car. I'm sorry that I couldn't win a DisCar for y'all. But after going there, I really think My Best Cool Car is too good for the DisCars.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm not good at talking right now, so I might not be fully expressing the gratitude in my heart.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But I've prepared some gifts.

She rummages through her lion's head. The first thing she takes out is an envelope, which contains a smaller red envelope inside. It looks old, but its fine embossing and delicate gold patterns are quite exquisite.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is called a "lai see." The lion dancing folks gave it to me. It contains DisCoins that I've saved.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No no, I cannot accept this...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <size=32>It's not a salary, it's a blessing. Every year around this time, the kids in Goldionville get these blessings from the grownups. This is my blessing for Lynn. I hope you can become a photographer, go wherever you want and take pictures of whatever you like.</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: If you ever feel like you're short on courage again, you can come to the Drifter Camp and use this money to buy candies of courage from the architect. The candy I gave you also came from him. You don't have to worry about lacking courage ever again.
She continues to rummage.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is some herbal tea, for Love. This'll help you cool down every once in a while, so that you can keep burning with passion in a sustainable way.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: This is a yellow paper talisman, with Goldionville calligraphy on it. I've seen them in some Outlander horror films before. I think Daisy will like it... No, don't put it on your forehead.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Next time you guys come to hang out, I'll make my favorite dim sum dishes for y'all... When I grow up a bit more, I'll try to get the flavor as authentic as possible.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: My DisCars journey is about to end. Tonight, I will leave My Best Cool Car Studios, and stop updating this vlog.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Next, I have some secrets to tell ${PlayerName} and Stella. They're private, so I don't want anyone else to hear them. So it's time to turn off the camera...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content:
Goodbye, everyone...
Bye-bye! Thank you for staying with me all this time!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Didn't we agree to turn off the camera? Why are you still here... I don't have any secrets to tell. Sorry, I was lying... If I didn't say that, everyone would've tried to stay...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Could it be the lion's head? Is OwO going to teach me how to lion dance?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Pfft, why would I give that to you? The lion's head is my treasure! It's already a big privilege that I let you touch it.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...I do have a gift for you, though. It's My Best Cool Car.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Isn't that mine to begin with?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Also all the good memories, the little inspirations during filming, the tidbits and chance encounters, and my special secrets...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Disclaimer! These are all treasures to me, and I'm really reluctant to give them away. But OwO must keep going forward, so I leave them to you as souvenirs.

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sniff... Don't worry, I won't be defeated so easily. I'm the best Lion Dancing Queen in the whole wide world. I still have a lot to do, so I have no time to be sad.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella, tomorrow I'll take you to find your family. We were so close last time! We almost succeeded. Once you get back to them, they'll get better and won't be angry anymore. They'll be just as nice as you.

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Squeak... Squeak!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You still have a homeland, Stella. I promise to send you home.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What are you talking about? Didn't you come to make movies? OwO's awesome, but don't get too clingy towards me. Don't forget about your own dreams.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: From today onwards, you're no longer an intern. You're now a full-time employee and the pillar of My Best Cool Car Studios. You must carry forward our spirit!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'll still be following your work after leaving the film industry! I'll continue to watch you, your films, and stories!
She waves her little fists indignantly, but soon runs out of steam.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...I'll be watching you all the time. You won't be alone.
She falls into silence, and doesn't lift up her head again.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What... I'm not crying...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Of course, OwO is the strongest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let me stay with you. It doesn't matter if you don't make it into a movie. I just want to see how the story ends.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No one can tell you what to do. It's your story. You decide when it ends.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You think I'm a dummy? I don't need you to comfort me...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The DisCars are so lame. My Best Cool Car has better things to do. So does the Lion Dancing Queen...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What about the sad things? Let it out. Don't hold back. You have me by your side, Lion Dancing Queen.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ... You're so annoying... I was the one covering for you all this time. Acting all tough now that you've become a full-time hire? You big numskull!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Hey, don't talk in the language I don't understand.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I can say whatever I want! You dimwit, you nitwit, you great big nincompoop!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Seems like you have a knack for remembering fancy insults.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Why do you talk so much? Let me finish! I'll be fine by tomorrow. I already have a home and people who love me. Plus, I'm really awesome myself!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Okay. I won't say any more.

steps.content: You stop talking, and reach out to wipe her tears. Her eyes are bright red from crying non-stop. You can't wipe away the tears fast enough. They keep streaming down like a waterfall, splashing onto the lion head's colorful fabric.
Her head lowered, she chokes and shudders, no longer able to string together a full sentence.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I-I only saw them six times. I only remember, six times... I almost can't remember what they look like anymore...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: They wouldn't let me learn their language... They wouldn't let me t-touch the lion head... But when I danced, they w-were happier than anyone else...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I know I'm different from the people here... OwO is from the Outlands. I look different, I eat different food, and I used to speak a different language.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: DisCity is so huge, and there are bad people who hate me. They always mock and bully me because I'm different. Because I'm all alone.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Ha, I'm not afraid of them. I beat them all up.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: So what if I'm an Outlander? The folks who gave me the lion's head told me that the kids in Goldionville are all majestic lions. No matter where I go, the lions will find me. I won't let them down.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm already a majestic Lion Dancing Queen, and I want them to see that. If they can't come to me, I'll find a way to go back to them.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: When I meet them again, they'll praise me for being so hardworking and impressive! They'll be proud of me, I'm sure of it!

steps.speaker: Option
options: Yes. You're indeed very hardworking and impressive.

steps.content: You bring her into your arms.
In that moment, OwO's forced smile finally collapses. In an unlit corner of the night, the girl bursts into sobs.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sob... I can't go back to Goldionville... I don't have a homeland anymore...

steps.speaker: Wynn
steps.content: Chief... We've detected activity from the Apostle's main body again. The FAC headquarters have drawn up a battle plan. Let me send it to you. You...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Request for simultaneous combat. Stella is indeed different from the other clones. With Stella around, there are other ways to defeat the Apostle of Ashes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO has made her own decision. My Best Cool Car... has gotten a <color=#fb9259>new script</color>.
